what: What could be shown at the head of the sheet of each country that is named (scripts/data/heads-asked.txt): the pictures Wikidata shows what the country is known by with (what UNESCO lists as World Heritage, its national parks, what is called a tourist attraction, its capital and its highest point). items: of each country, by its id, its candidates (sights), the best known of each kind first: the file, the kind (heritage, park, sight, capital, top), the entity it is of (of), how many Wikipedias tell of it (links) and its name (es, en). files: what Commons says of each file, by its title: SHA-1, bytes, MIME type, width and height of the original, licence and its address, author, credit, whether it must be attributed and its page; and where the small picture of it, 330 px wide, is kept in this branch (picture), to choose among them by eye. Only photographs at least 1900 px wide and between 1.25 and 2.4 times wider than tall are candidates. Nothing is chosen here: the one that stays is written in scripts/data/profiles-heads.json and brought by the source photos.
